lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate the remaining test subtrees to derived zero tree-wide

nextStoryContext: US-007 closed the last 14 remaining test subtrees (config, release, unit, orchestrator, transcript, issues, vendor, plan, notify, logging, interactivity, fixtures, domain-docs, retry): all 26 files carrying a join(tmpdir() rooting spelling (47 occurrences) were rewritten by `bun scripts/codemod-test-tmpdir.ts` in one pass, including the awaited `mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), ...))` form in test/retry/config.test.ts and test/retry/logger.test.ts (await on the now-synchronous createTestTmpdir resolves immediately) and the non-`*.test.ts` fixture module test/fixtures/resume/scenario.ts. test/retry's MIT-licensed src headers were untouched (codemod only rewrites imports/call sites); AC3's rmSync/MIT count-parity oracle against main passed with zero deltas. The tree-wide oracle (`grep -rnHE 'join\(\s*tmpdir\(\)' test/` filtered for comment lines) is now EMPTY: this PRD's target state (derived count of zero rooting sites tree-wide) is reached as of this story. Only one non-codemod fix was needed: test/domain-docs/write-on-main.test.ts had a bare mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), ...)) reached via a DYNAMIC `await import('node:fs')`/`await import('node:os')` destructure inside a single test body (not the codemod's recognized static `import { ... } from '...';` form, and the only such occurrence anywhere in test/); hand-removed the two now-dead destructured names (mkdtempSync, tmpdir) rather than extending the codemod for a one-off shape. GOTCHA 11 (test/vendor/check-agent-frontmatter-standalone.test.ts) is resolved by the migration itself, confirmed measured: 0.126s for 2 tests post-migration vs the prior 4.433s under the bloated shared $TMPDIR, with zero budget-ceiling edit. Full bun test: 6047 pass / 0 fail (same count as US-006's baseline -- this story only rewrote existing call sites, no new tests added). bun run check:all green, no file-size/coverage _ref raise needed. scripts/codemod-test-tmpdir.ts and test/codemod-test-tmpdir.test.ts were NOT modified this story (zero new codemod edge cases; the codemod has now run clean, unmodified, across US-005/US-007's two fronts in a row after the US-003/US-004/US-006 fixes). US-008 (next) adds a deterministic tmpdir gate (falsifiability probe + empty allowlist mechanism) that should key off the exact same grep spelling this story just drove to zero -- the informative-reference oracle text in US-001..US-007 (`grep -rnHE "join\(\s*tmpdir\(\)" test/`, comment-lines filtered via `grep -vE "^[^:]+:[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*(//|\*|/\*)"`) is very likely the exact shape US-008's gate script should encode, now that it is provably zero tree-wide; the empty allowlist mechanism should still exist as a structural escape hatch even though nothing currently needs to be in it. US-002's test/helpers/test-tmpdir.ts and its own test file remain the only files where `tmpdir(` legitimately appears in the tree (as a bare comparand / doc-comment mention, never spelled `join(tmpdir(), ...)`) -- US-008's gate must not false-positive on those.
